description: Run write steps in order. A step can use earlier results through $variables. With stop_on_error, a failure undoes created nodes and changed properties, but not deletes, group/ungroup, detach, reparent, or steps that target nodes by name.

steps.description: Steps in order: {id, action, params, export_vars?}

action.description: Tool name to run e.g. create_frame

id.description: Step ID, used by $variables in later steps

stop_on_error.description: Stop and undo on error (default true)

name: batch_execute_pipeline
